title: Minimum Index
statement: You are given an integer array nums of length n. For every index i (0 <= i < n), leftXor is the bitwise XOR of all elements from index 0 to i (inclusive), and rightXor is the bitwise XOR of all elements from index i + 1 to n - 1. If i is the last index, then rightXor = 0. Return the smallest index i such that leftXor > rightXor. If no such index exists, return -1.

examples.explanation: At i = 0, leftXor = 4 and rightXor = 2 XOR 5 XOR 7 XOR 1 XOR 3 = 2. Since 4 > 2, the answer is 0.
At i = 0, leftXor = 8 and rightXor = 1, so 8 > 1.
At i = 1, leftXor = 1 XOR 8 = 9 and rightXor = 0, so 9 > 0.

hints: Hint 1: Precompute total XOR of the full array.
Hint 2: Sweep left to right while maintaining prefix XOR.
Hint 3: rightXor at index i can be derived from totalXor XOR leftXor.
Hint 4: Return immediately when you find the first index satisfying leftXor > rightXor.
discussion: Try discussing edge cases like single-element arrays and arrays with all zeros.
